explanation: Active only at the GO step, and only when the agent chooses a1 right after a trial in which it chose a1, reached S1 through the common transition and was rewarded; then it is about 9-10 (8-9 after long streaks). It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step, at every a2 choice, after an unrewarded trial, and after a rewarded trial that reached S2 through a rare transition, even if a1 is chosen again.
